definitions.explanation: The state of being extremely poor.

examples.japanese: {貧困|ひんこん}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す。
{子供|こども}の{貧困|ひんこん}が{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Child poverty has become a social issue.

examples.japanese: {貧困|ひんこん}{層|そう}を{支援|しえん}する。

notes:
{貧困|ひんこん} refers to poverty—a state of extreme lack of financial resources. It can function as a noun or na-adjective.

TYPES:
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}{貧困|ひんこん}: absolute poverty (lacking basic needs)
- {相対的|そうたいてき}{貧困|ひんこん}: relative poverty (below societal standards)
- {子|こ}どもの{貧困|ひんこん}: child poverty

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {貧困|ひんこん}{層|そう}: the impoverished class
- {貧困|ひんこん}{率|りつ}: poverty rate
- {貧困|ひんこん}{線|せん}: poverty line
- {貧困|ひんこん}{問題|もんだい}: poverty problem

PATTERNS:
- {貧困|ひんこん}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into poverty
- {貧困|ひんこん}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す: to escape from poverty
- {貧困|ひんこん}を{撲滅|ぼくめつ}する: to eradicate poverty

RELATED:
- {貧|まず}しい: poor (adjective)
- {貧乏|びんぼう}: poor, poverty (more colloquial)
